items.title: 5.1 Classification of solids (solids ki qismein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.1 with the chapter's opening paragraph (PDF 93-95).

blocks.text: Har material ka apna khaas istemal hota hai, jo us ki properties (khoobiyon) par depend karta hai, jaise hardness (sakhti), ductility (taar ban sakne ki ability) aur malleability (chadar ban sakne ki ability). Steel sakht aur lead (seesa) naram kyun hai? Is ka jawab material ki structure (banawat) mein hai: atoms aur molecules kis tarteeb mein hain aur aapas mein kaise jure (bonded) hain. Isi tarah behte hue fluids (liquids aur gases) ka study mushkil hai, lekin kuch assumptions (farz ki hui baatein) maan kar ise aasaan kiya ja sakta hai. Do conservation principles (kisi cheez ke qaim rehne ke qaide) is ko aur aasaan banate hain: mass ka conservation aur energy ka conservation. Mass ke conservation se equation of continuity milti hai, aur energy ka conservation Bernoulli's theorem ki base (bunyad) hai.
